layout: Single screen, light bg (#F8FAFC). Content is vertically centered with consistent spacing. Same layout structure as Step 2 and Step 3 — only the middle content changes.

layout_structure.top_bar: Ghost back arrow (top-left, DISABLED/lighter for step 1), 'Skip for now' link (top-right, slate #94A3B8)
layout_structure.progress: Step indicator centered below top bar: 3 dot circles in a row. Step 1: ORANGE (#FF8A34) filled. Step 2: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined. Step 3: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined.
layout_structure.illustration: Large icon (dumbbell/target for Goal) centered, ~80px, in blue (#003F8C)
layout_structure.heading: 'What's your goal?' — navy (#0B1B3B), h2 (24px), bold, centered
layout_structure.subtitle: 'Pilih tujuan latihan kamu' — slate (#64748B), body (16px), centered
layout_structure.content_area: 3 large selection cards stacked vertically, 16px gap between cards
layout_structure.cta: Button 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, 14px/24px padding, 12px radius. DISABLED (gray #94A3B8, no shadow) until a goal is selected.
layout_structure.spacing: 24px between each section. 16px horizontal padding on mobile, 32px on desktop.

elements: TOP BAR: Back arrow (ghost, disabled — lighter gray #CBD5E1) left. 'Skip for now' link (slate #94A3B8, small 14px) right.
PROGRESS: 3 horizontal dots. Dot 1: orange (#FF8A34) filled circle. Dot 2: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined circle. Dot 3: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined circle.
HEADING: 'What's your goal?' centered, navy #0B1B3B, bold, 24px.
SUBTITLE: 'Pilih tujuan latihan kamu' centered, slate #64748B, 16px.

Card 1: White bg, 16px radius, subtle shadow, 20px padding. Left: weight/muscle icon (large, #003F8C). Center: 'Bulk (Massa Otot)' bold navy + 'Membangun massa otot dan kekuatan' small slate. Right: radio circle. Unselected: gray border. Selected: orange (#FF8A34) border 2px + radio filled orange.
Card 2: Same layout. Icon: scale/measuring. Title: 'Cut (Defisit Kalori)'. Desc: 'Membakar lemak dan membentuk tubuh'.
Card 3: Same layout. Icon: heart/lungs. Title: 'Endurance (Daya Tahan)'. Desc: 'Meningkatkan stamina dan kebugaran'.
CTA: 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, 14px/24px padding, 12px radius, shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(255,138,52,0.3). Disabled state: bg #CBD5E1, no shadow, cursor not-allowed.
notes: IDENTICAL LAYOUT to 03b and 03c — only content area changes. Cards are min 72px height for easy tapping. Selected state is unmistakable (orange border + filled radio).
